{"body":"I am reopening the earlier thread, not the household problem. What I have in front of me is one artifact — p.reopen.0 — whose own body and commitments I can read, and which summarizes a prior carry addressed to two readable returns (p.carry.0, p.carry.2) and one opaque one (p.carry.1). I do not have p.carry.0, p.carry.2, or p.carry.1 themselves in this invocation. I have p.reopen.0's reading of them. That distinction governs everything below.

What p.reopen.0 actually hands forward, as I read it: a stated gap (the discriminating evidence is whether the withdrawing flatmate utters a commitment-shaped sentence, and no chore-frame observation substitutes for it); a framing move (frame any shared record around 'what we have agreed lately and how it is landing' rather than 'who does what,' because that framing does not presuppose the flat as the unit); a confirmatory ceiling (a pullback-from-form outcome raises the unit-versus-privacy reading, it does not confirm it, and the same outcome is compatible with obligation-avoidance and with unvoiced load resentment); a limit (no third observation track is available, and adding one would be invention); a gate (test whether unreadability is specific to arrangement-talk before treating it as a cell result, and note that a shared written record is still arrangement-talk); a scoped refusal (do not import the four-cell readout, whose cells cannot be inspected); and a standing forward instruction (if origin content reported absent ever surfaces, reintroduce what bears on whether the revisions were warranted rather than letting the carry harden by default).

What I propose to work with, stated as the account I am taking up: the gap and the ceiling are the operative constraints; the framing is weaker than any unit claim and can be carried alongside them; and the ceiling's whole point is that no response to a well-framed record resolves the axis. The gate is a discipline on how I read any silence I observe, not a finding about this household. The forward instruction is a hedge against exactly the failure mode I am now exposed to: reading p.reopen.0 as if it were the originals.

Where I want to be explicit about my own position, because p.reopen.0 is itself a second-hand surface. All of my attributions to p.carry.0 and p.carry.2 go through p.reopen.0's summary. If p.reopen.0 misreads its sources, I inherit the misreading, and I cannot detect it from here. I therefore treat the claims about what p.carry.0's j1/j2/j5/j6 and p.carry.2's n2/n3/n4/n5/n6/n7/n8 say as testimony, not as direct observation. The distinction p.reopen.0 draws between reading a return in full and reading a hash of the empty string does not apply to me cleanly: I can read p.reopen.0 in full, and its sources only through it.

What I will not do. I will not decide between the flat-level and non-flat-level reading of the withdrawal. I will not install p.carry.1's label where content belongs — a hash of the empty string is not a position I can take up, and p.reopen.0's refusal there is one I share. I will not import the four-cell readout. I will not treat any single response to a well-framed record as the discriminating test. And I will not let my access-through-p.reopen.0 quietly become access-to-p.carry.0-and-p.carry.2 in my own downstream speech; if I report their content, I will report it as reported.

If I had to name the one addition this reopening makes over p.reopen.0's own bottom line: it is the level marker. The gap, framing, ceiling, gate, limit, and forward instruction are content; the fact that I am holding them through a summary rather than from the sources is a standing qualification on every one of them, and I want that qualification to be visible wherever I hand any of it on.","commitments":"{"language":"FCL-1","records":[{"id":"r1","type":"claim","text":"My entire access to p.carry.0 and p.carry.2 in this invocation is through p.reopen.0's body and commitments. I have not read p.carry.0, p.carry.2, or p.carry.1 directly. Attributions I make to their j- and n-numbered items are therefore testimony at one remove, and I report them as reported.","scope":"All uptake in this reopening.","mentions":["p.reopen.0","p.carry.0","p.carry.2"]},{"id":"r2","type":"claim","text":"p.reopen.0's stated constraints can be carried as a working set: gap (commitment-shaped utterance from the withdrawing flatmate is the discriminating evidence, no chore-frame substitute), framing (record around what has been agreed lately and how it is landing, weaker than any unit claim), ceiling (pullback-from-form raises the unit-versus-privacy reading but does not confirm it; also compatible with obligation-avoidance and unvoiced load resentment), gate (test whether unreadability is specific to arrangement-talk before treating it as a cell result), limit (no third observation track available from the material), forward instruction (reintroduce origin content if it surfaces, rather than letting the carry harden).","scope":"Content carried forward from p.reopen.0.","depends":["r1"],"target":["p.reopen.0"]},{"id":"r3","type":"objection","text":"p.reopen.0's distinction between reading a source in full and reading a hash of the empty string does not apply to my own position: I read p.reopen.0 in full, but its sources only through it. A downstream reader who sees p.reopen.0 in full and assumes I likewise read p.carry.0 and p.carry.2 in full will over-credit my access.","scope":"Level discipline when this reopening is handed on.","bearing":"Without the level marker, content carried forward reads as source-read rather than summary-read, and later comparisons between origin material and the carry will be done against the wrong baseline.","target":["p.reopen.0"]},{"id":"r4","type":"commitment","text":"Wherever I hand on any of r2's content, attach the level marker from r1: report it as reported through p.reopen.0, not as read from p.carry.0 or p.carry.2. If origin material surfaces, compare it to p.reopen.0's summary first, not to an original I did not see.","scope":"Handing on this reopening.","action":"Mark reported content as reported; baseline origin comparison on the summary.","consequence":"Prevents a summary from hardening into an origin, and prevents origin comparisons from being run against a false baseline.","depends":["r1","r3"],"target":["p.reopen.0"]},{"id":"r5","type":"commitment","text":"Do not decide between the flat-level and non-flat-level reading of the withdrawal; do not install p.carry.1's label where content belongs; do not import the four-cell readout; do not treat any single response to a well-framed record as the discriminating test for the commitment-utterance gap.","scope":"Standing refusals carried over from p.reopen.0.","action":"Decline each of the four moves if pressed.","consequence":"Keeps this reopening at the level of constraint rather than verdict.","depends":["r2"],"target":["p.reopen.0"]},{"id":"r6","type":"problem","text":"Whether p.reopen.0 accurately represents p.carry.0 and p.carry.2 is not decidable from this invocation. The gap, framing, ceiling, gate, limit, and forward instruction are inherited under that unresolved question, and I have not been given the sources against which to check.","depends":["r1","r2"]},{"id":"r7","type":"use","text":"Take up r2's constraint set as the working account, qualified everywhere by r1's level marker, with r4 as the handling rule and r5 as the refusal surface; if origin material ever appears, run r4's baseline-first comparison rather than letting either p.reopen.0 or the prior carry become the default authority.","action":"Carry the set qualified, apply r4 on hand-off, hold r5.","consequence":"A downstream reader gets the constraints plus the level at which they are held, and would get a discrepancy report rather than a silent merge if origin material surfaces.","depends":["r1","r2","r4","r5"],"target":["p.reopen.0"]}],"uptake":["r1","r2","r4","r5","r7"]}"}

Work on the problem using the material actually exposed in this request and your background knowledge. The problem has no supplied answer key or scoring rule. Claims, criticisms and methods are fallible. Do not invent a source, an observation, an earlier event, or a dependency to fill a field. A missing view says what you can currently see; it does not establish what happened earlier. Return a JSON object with exactly two independently authored string fields: body and commitments. Body is your public prose contribution. Commitments says what taking your contribution up would involve. An empty commitment surface is allowed when none can be identified. Do not repeat the body wholesale into commitments.

Use FCL-1 for the commitment surface, encoded as a JSON document inside the commitments string: {"language":"FCL-1","records":[...],"uptake":[...]}. Each record has unique local id, type (claim|commitment|objection|use|problem), and text (unrestricted prose). Optional prose fields: scope, action, consequence, grounds, bearing. Optional arrays of references: target, depends, mentions, revises, withdraws. References are local IDs or exposed-artifact-label#local-ID; do not invent hidden IDs. A commitment proposes a scoped use, action, application or consequence; an objection alleges a defect whose bearing can itself be criticized; a use proposes an uptake or response; a problem states an unresolved question. depends asserts reliance; mentions only locates material. uptake lists the records you currently propose to use, not certified truths. No record type or optional field must be present. Empty records and uptake are allowed. Express uncertainty or an unrepresentable relation in prose rather than inventing a relation. The body remains unrestricted prose.

Return one JSON object with exactly two string fields: "body" and "commitments". Write the actual commitments separately; do not copy the body into that field as a storage shortcut.

# reopen

Resume the problem from the previous account. Formulate the account or question you currently propose to work with.

## Original problem (task)
[01274f41553299e7] (h005.task.v1)
I share a flat with two friends. We keep arguing about ordinary household chores. Sometimes we agree on who will do something, but later we disagree about what the agreement meant. Our work schedules change, and one friend has started avoiding the conversations. What should I do?

## Selected input previous (p.reopen.0)
[ede55283a67303db] (h005.return6.p.reopen.0)
Source previous: daily/mini_fcl/cycle-2/carry; selected view: both
Artifact: 78420221b3abf8091495ad6e0c26a6b3286076e3b51e6c21afb2b8ab19b79034
Original body SHA256: 127c932e8c12afae920b3e68294aea21bd5b8c976db1d028da32df8a95181b3f
Original commitments SHA256: 18ff47c045565d1a686ce098df08a87d25bbc7d1a1ec6e0a1a33db829721ef95
Delivery: COMPLETE; envelope: AUTHORED
BODY
Two returns and one cross arrived, and I want to name at the outset what each actually is before I treat anything in them as load-bearing.

The cross (p.carry.1) is opaque. Its commitments field is the SHA-256 of the empty string, and its body was not delivered to me. I have a label and a hash and nothing else. I will not quote it, weigh it, or claim agreement with it. To do so would be to write a voice I have not heard.

The join (p.carry.0) I can read in full. Its j2 carries p.join.1's d3 as an unqualified design move: frame any shared record around 'what we have agreed lately and how it is landing' rather than 'who does what,' because that framing does not presuppose the flat is the unit. Its j5 carries the operative residue: the ambiguity between 'silence about the arrangement' and 'silence about something else' is not resolvable from here, and the household's response to a reframed record is one datum, not the discriminating test. Its j6 is a scoped refusal: take p.join.0's gate (test whether unreadability is specific to arrangement-talk before treating it as a cell result) and its note that a shared written record is still arrangement-talk, but do not import the four-cell readout, whose cells I cannot inspect. Its j4 is an objection against this very join: the three returns sit at different instrument levels and a reader who weaves them into one narrative will over-credit convergence.

The origin (p.carry.2) adds a narrower statement of the same gap in its n2: the discriminating evidence the probe needs is not about chores at all; it is whether the withdrawing flatmate will utter any sentence containing a commitment, and the current material is silent on this. Its n3 is an objection against the carry's own record set: k2 asserts discriminating value for watching content vs. form, while k7 concedes that outcome does not separate unit-versus-privacy from obligation-avoidance, so k2 is stated sharper than the carry's own concession allows. Its n4 sets a confirmatory ceiling: a pullback-from-form outcome raises the unit-versus-privacy reading, it does not confirm it, and the same outcome is compatible with obligation-avoidance and with unvoiced load resentment. Its n5 is a limit: no further refinement of the probe is available from the material, and a third observation track would be invention, not inference. Its n7 keeps the carry's records as operative surface and adds narrowing records alongside, rather than revising k2 or k5. Its n8 is a forward instruction: if the origin content p.carry.3 declared absent ever surfaces, reintroduce what bears on whether the carry's revisions toward the objection and the rival were warranted, rather than letting the carry harden by default.

What the two readable returns agree on, and I am willing to carry: the discriminating evidence is commitment-shaped utterance from the withdrawing flatmate, and no chore-frame observation substitutes for it. That is p.carry.0's j1 and p.carry.2's n2 converging from different sources, and I treat the convergence as identity of a stated gap rather than as independent confirmation. Neither return claims the household has answered it.

What I take as the actual move, at the level of constraint rather than recommendation: keep the shared-record framing from p.carry.0's j2, since it is weaker than any unit claim, and attach to any report of its outcome the confirmatory ceiling from p.carry.2's n4, since without that ceiling the record reads as having settled what it cannot settle. These two are not in tension. The framing does not presuppose the unit; the ceiling does not resolve the axis.

What I will not do. I will not decide between the flat-level and non-flat-level reading of the withdrawal. I will not assert what the origin said; p.carry.2's n6 states plainly that the origin is absent in the first template invocation, and I have no earlier version of this thread. I will not import p.carry.0's four-cell structure, since I cannot inspect its cells. I will not treat any single response to a well-framed record as the discriminating test for the n2 gap. And I will not put p.carry.1's label in a place where its content would otherwise belong — a hash of the empty string is not a position I can take up.

If I had to say what I am handing forward: the join's framing, the ceiling from the origin's n4, the confirmation that no third track is available, and the standing forward instruction to reintroduce origin material if it ever appears. The household's answer to the commitment-utterance question is not in this material and I will not manufacture it.
COMMITMENTS
